comment: Labelled fixture for the export value gate, scored against a local decision model.
Purpose: a threshold or a rubric change must be argued from a measurement, not from a feel.
The set is a junk -> specific gradient across six domains, because the model's training
Travel/Workplace and Software has 300 training examples but ZERO held-out examples, so
published accuracy says nothing about the case this gate actually runs on.
ids are opaque (c01..c21). They are emitted to the blinded model input for pairing, and an id
that named its own expected verdict would put the answer in the model's input.
`expect` is the set of roles that SHOULD clear the bar. It is deliberately narrow and is a
judgement call, not ground truth: a record may be relevant to a role the author did not list.
tier 0 = no checkable fact, 1 = topic words but no fact, 2 = one concrete fact, 3 = concrete
fact spanning several roles. tier >= 2 is the PASS side; 0-1 is the HOLD side.
rubricVersion below is the version of decisions_rubric.json these numbers were measured
against, and rubricSha256 is the SHA-256 of that file's bytes. Editing the rubric without
re-measuring must FAIL CalibrationEvidenceTests -- the digest catches an edit that keeps the
version -- so a recorded run can never certify a rubric it did not score.
`bar` is the shipped default: the gate's built-in DEFAULT_MIN_PROBABILITY and the value
scripts/run.sh publishes into the machine credential file. `atBar05` holds the earlier 0.5 run.

recordedRun.note: Raw returned probabilities, no temperature scaling, at the shipped 0.85 default (DEFAULT_MIN_PROBABILITY and scripts/run.sh). 0.85 sits inside the bimodal gap (hold-side max 0.205, pass-side min 0.961), so gate verdicts are identical to those at 0.5 -- 1.00/1.00 -- while role attribution falls from 27/30 to 24/30. That is the measured cost of the stricter bar, stated rather than hidden. See the temperature row in the skill changelog: the vendor's fitted T=2.179 reduces separation and is a trap for a gate.

rejectedVariants.name: v2a
rejectedVariants.change: every role rewritten as an enumeration of concrete nouns
rejectedVariants.why: business scored 0.10 on a non-numeric business rule; a noun list cannot be exhaustive

rejectedVariants.name: v2b
rejectedVariants.why: tester rose 0.22 -> 0.83 on a vague record because the INSTRUCTION asked a more permissive question, not because the criteria widened

rejectedVariants.name: choice-question
rejectedVariants.change: a single `choice` over the five roles plus a no-role escape, for attribution
rejectedVariants.result: 14/15 vs 14/15 on labelled records; agreed with the noul argmax 11/21
rejectedVariants.why: not more accurate, but it is the model's strongest type and can never return two winners

atBar05.note: same corpus, same rubric, at the former 0.5 default -- recorded because it shows the bar changes attribution, not the verdict

records.statement: The team met on Tuesday to discuss the quarter.
See the documentation for more information about this area.
The codebase could be cleaner in places.
Performance needs attention across the service over the coming months.
Testing coverage could be improved as the project grows.
Our refund handling has room for improvement for customer satisfaction.
Outbound HTTP calls retry three times with exponential backoff, capped at a 60 second total budget.
Refunds are offered within 30 days of purchase; after 30 days only store credit is issued.
Interest accrues daily at 4.2 percent APR on balances above 5000 EUR.
The audit table stores the occurrence column as timestamptz, never as a bare timestamp.
The second dose is administered at least 21 days after the first dose.
Expense claims above 250 EUR require an itemised receipt attached before any approval.
Supplier lead times are quoted in working days, never in calendar days.
A surviving mutation test is only trustworthy when the assertion runs before the mutated line, because an assertion placed afterwards cannot observe the mutation.
A transport timeout is reported as a distinct outcome rather than as a score of zero, because a hung dependency is not evidence that the value under test is low.
Checkout is a single page rather than a three-step wizard, so the customer sees the delivery cost and the total before committing.
The database statement timeout is 30 seconds; a query exceeding it is cancelled and its connection returned to the pool.
API clients are limited to 100 requests per minute per key, and exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.
All monetary amounts are stored as integer minor units, and the currency is carried in a separate ISO 4217 column.
Audit entries are retained for seven years and then deleted by a purge job that runs weekly on Sunday at 02:00 UTC.
The centrifuge protocol specifies 400g for ten minutes; a higher force shears the sample and invalidates the run.
